items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Ray Badu, Leo Addy and myself, the three of us, we used to all go in there, we'd copy all the Baby's licks.

ctx.x: You didn't call them accessories. They called them traps. And you could, uh, you could use the cymbal on top and, and, and, and the, and the foot pedal. And they always had a little, a little, a little attachment on, on the, on the pedal there. And you'd put a cymbal down on the side of the bass drum and it would hit the, hit the bass drum and the cymbal simultaneously like that. You know, to give that, that little whatchacom. And, uh, there's no, no such thing as, uh, is, uh, hi-hats or anything like that. Cause…
Just about a foot off the floor?
